comments.note: createWorkPackage() in src/tools/work-package.ts lacked the _ledgerRoot test-hook parameter that propagateDependencyUnblock already uses. Added it to enable isolated unit testing without polluting the centralized ledger storage. Pattern is now consistent across the two side-effect-heavy tool functions.

The existing integration tests in tests/integration/full-workflow.test.ts set revision: 1 in direct fixture writes rather than calling createWorkPackage. These tests remain valid (they exercise store behavior, not tool defaults), but new WPs created via the MCP tool will have revision: 0 going forward. No action needed — just noted for awareness.

src/schema/work-package.ts had no dedicated Zod parse-level tests before this WP. The new tests/schema/work-package-schema.test.ts fills this gap and will catch future regressions in schema field definitions.

comments.note: The rework_counts map permits all four keys as .optional() — meaning an empty {} object is a valid schema value. Per §16.2 the map should be lazily created with all-zero entries on first rework. Downstream writers (WP-002 migration) handle initialization correctly. Later phases that increment rework counters will need to default absent keys to 0 before incrementing. Non-blocking for Phase 1.

status_changed_at uses z.string() without ISO 8601 format validation, consistent with all other timestamp fields in the codebase (started_at, completed_at, etc.). This is a deliberate pattern — Zod datetime validation is stricter than required. No action needed.
No improvement — code is clean and consistent.
